items.title: Gene muntaqil karne ke tareeqe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the methods of gene transfer (PDF 162-163).

blocks.text: Gene target cell mein us ki membrane ya wall ke raaste cell ko tabah kiye baghair muntaqil hota hai. Poora kaseer-ul-khaliya GMO banane ke liye gene gamete ya gamete banane wale tissue mein dala jata aur aise gametes mila kar GMOs banaye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Chhe khane, har aik mein aik cell: electroporation (bijli ka jhatka pores kholta), microinjection (barik sui nucleus tak), biolistic (heavy metal se lipta gene, gene gun), protoplast tareeqa (cell wall hatayi, protoplast DNA wale medium mein), kimiyai tareeqa (DNA aur kimiyai maadda, endocytosis) aur virus ke zariye (virus gene le jata).
blocks.caption: Gene ko cell mein dalne ke chhe tareeqe (kitab ki fehrist (a)-(f) ke liye hamara asal khaaka; kitab mein is ki koi figure nahi).
Gene muntaqil karne ke tareeqe
rows: barqi current wall ya membrane mein soorakh banata hai jo gene ko andar aane deta; current khatam hone par soorakh band ho jate
bareek sui gene seedha nucleus mein dalti hai
bhaari dhaat (nanhe zarron) par chadha gene mekanki taqat, maslan gene gun, se cell mein dhakela jata
cell wall hata kar protoplast ko gene wale medium mein milaya jata
nanga DNA kimiyai maadde se milaya jata; yeh majmooa diffusion ya endocytosis se cytoplasm mein jata
adenovirus, adeno-associated virus, HIV, lentivirus aur doosre retroviruses gene le jate

blocks.prompt: Sakht wall wale paude ke cell ke liye, sui ke baghair, kaun sa tareeqa munasib hoga?
blocks.explanation: Biolistic transformation (gene gun DNA chadhe zarre wall ke paar daagti hai); wall hata kar protoplast banana doosra raasta hai.

items: Electroporation, microinjection, gene gun, protoplasts, kimiyai maadde, viruses.
